title: First and Last Call On the Same Day
summary: Return users whose first and last call on at least one calendar date involved the same other person.
inputFormat: Calls(caller_id, recipient_id, call_time); a call involves both users.
tieRules: Timestamp ties for first and last calls not settled.
edgeRules: A date with a single call: whether it counts is not stated.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: On day D: user A calls B at 09:00, A calls C at 18:00, and B calls A at 20:00. A first and last calls are both with B, so A qualifies. Without the 20:00 call, A would not qualify.
